How to read this
  • One lane per install (first_open), China excluded. x is time since that player's own install, in 10-minute steps, up to 14 days. The pale bar is the player's lifetime: first to last event of any kind within 14 days.
  • Normalized stacks each build's players as “top N%”, so a 300-player build and a 3,000-player build overlay directly. Player count gives one lane per player, so the bigger build is taller.
  • Overlay draws A (blue) and B (orange) on top of each other for one thing at a time: lifetime, or first-to-last of one event. Separate draws each build in its own panel with every selected event as a coloured tick.
  • Only players observed for the whole range drops installs too recent to have had the full zoom window. Leave it on when comparing builds, or a new build looks like it churns faster.
  • Events: session start, level win, level lose, rewarded ad (any placement), interstitial shown, shop click (purchase_click), IAP (in_app_purchase), idle replay, and app removed (uninstall — Android reports it, often hours later).
  • Build = the build the player installed on. Builds with fewer than 30 installs in the window are grouped as “other”. Campaign from AppsFlyer, joined on appsflyer_id: about 45% of installs match a paid campaign; the rest are Organic or Unattributed. Country is the first event's geo (IP-based).
  • Android only. The 14-day horizon and the 90-day install window both stop at the last complete day before any gap in the GA4 export.
